identity.title: Gas structure inside dust cavities of transition disks: Ophiuchus IRS 48 observed by ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present new high-resolution observations with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) of gas lines towards the transition disk Oph IRS 48 previously shown to host a large dust trap.

findings_qualitative.value: 12CO emission is partly absorbed by foreground cloud at vlsr ~2.0-4.5 km/s, causing asymmetries

evidence.quote: We conclude that some, but not all, of the asymmetries seen in the integrated intensity maps can be attributed to foreground absorption.

findings_qualitative.value: Photoevaporation alone is unlikely to form the cavities

evidence.loc: 5.1 The gas mass and surface density profile
evidence.quote: We thus conclude that in IRS 48 photoevaporation is unlikely the reason for the gap formation at 20 and 60 AU.

claims.hypothesis: Does the gas surface density drop inside the 60 AU dust cavity?
claims.experiment: Compared DALI models with different delta_60AU to the 12CO cut and spectrum
claims.result: Drop of a factor ~12 required for gamma=1
claims.finding: Gas is partly depleted but not removed inside the dust cavity

evidence.quote: We conclude that a drop in surface density at 60 AU by about a factor of $\sim$12 is required to fit the integrated intensity profile and reproduce the line width of the total spectrum.

claims.result: Drop of factor >=110; inner radius 20+-5 AU
claims.finding: Gas hole at 20 AU, only a limit on depth

evidence.quote: We conclude that the current data allows us to constrain a drop of a factor of $\gtrsim$110 in gas surface density profile at 20 AU.

claims.hypothesis: What is the total gas mass and gas-to-dust ratio?
claims.experiment: Fit 12CO and C17O flux with models
claims.finding: Low gas mass, ratio only marginally below ISM given a factor-of-few uncertainties

evidence.quote: this gas-to-dust ratio is however only marginally below the ISM value of 100.

claims.experiment: Compared derived profile with photoevaporation and planet predictions
claims.result: Drops moderate, accretion rate too high for photoevaporation
claims.finding: Points to one or more massive planets or companions

evidence.quote: The derived gas surface density profile points to the clearing of the cavity by one or more massive planet/companion rather than just photoevaporation or grain-growth.

why_this_method.value: Optically thick CO needs a model with chemistry and thermal balance to determine CO abundance in the UV-exposed cavity

evidence.quote: Such a model is also needed to determine the abundance of CO inside and outside the dust cavity since it is not a priori obvious that CO can survive in the dust-free gas exposed to intense UV radiation from the star.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Photoevaporation (X-ray and EUV) rejected as sole mechanism

evidence.loc: 5.1 The gas mass and surface density profile
evidence.quote: This accretion rate is also higher than typical EUV photoevaporation rates ((cite: Alexander06a; Alexander06)) ruling out EUV driven evaporation.

limitations_admitted.value: 12CO is optically thick so surface density is not directly constrained; profiles accurate only to a factor of a few

evidence.quote: We do not expect that derived surface density profiles are more accurate than a factor of a few.

limitations_admitted.value: Beam comparable to 20 AU hole, so only limits inside 20 AU
